what: AT&T is one of the largest US wireless carriers and a major fibre-broadband provider. After selling its media businesses it is focused on connectivity.
moat: A nationwide wireless network and one of the largest fibre footprints, sold together to keep customers.
opportunities: A dividend yield around 5% now covered by free cash flow
Fibre broadband wins customers from cable and holds them far longer
Mobile customers who also take fibre leave at much lower rates
watch: Postpaid phone net additions and fibre customer growth.
